I'm just a dumb user re lisp system facilities, so when I wanted to
run the Boston Globe ad I typed  :lisp mc:humor;lisp ad  to DDT.
It responded with a pause and then the message "GC CALLED FROM ALLOC - 
LOSE, LISP IS DEAD" and ".VAL 0; 126020>>HRLI 1,440700".

Have fun.     -  John Gilmore
